sourceTitle: Narrative of the Captivity and Restoration of Mrs. Mary Rowlandson
description: "Narrative of the Captivity and Restoration of Mrs. Mary Rowlandson" by Mary Rowlandson is a memoir published in 1682. During King Philip's War, Rowlandson and her three children were captured by Native Americans after an attack on their Massachusetts settlement.
